scope: Official-source research snapshot, followed by six separately recorded local implementations. Model and external-service validation are stated per implementation; local verification does not imply live inference or Host import.

projects.name: LangExtract
projects.proposed_workbench: 字段抽取复核：原文高亮与记录表联动
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: Python 核心＋自建任务服务；Apache-2.0
projects.decision: 首批；文本输入，保留证据区间与人工修订

implementation.upstream: 真实LangExtract库＋明确stub提供者；真实模型未验证

projects.name: Docling
projects.proposed_workbench: 文档解析校对：原页、结构树、表格修订
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 官方 docling-serve；代码 MIT，模型单列
projects.decision: 首批；CPU 服务可起步，处理部分解析失败

implementation.upstream: 真实Docling core HTML转换与原生JSON回读；官方Serve live未验证

projects.name: LightRAG
projects.proposed_workbench: 知识关系检查：图谱、来源片段、检索对照
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: Python 服务＋LLM/embedding；MIT
projects.decision: 有服务后优先；先只读图谱和检索

projects.name: GPT Researcher
projects.proposed_workbench: 研究报告台：稿件、大纲、引用核查抽屉
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: Python＋模型/搜索；根 Apache-2.0 与包 MIT 元数据冲突
projects.decision: 后续；先固定版本、确认许可依据

projects.name: Open Notebook
projects.proposed_workbench: 资料阅读台：来源树、双页阅读、知识卡片
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: Python＋SurrealDB；应用 MIT，数据库另计
projects.decision: 后续；已有实例时优先

projects.name: WrenAI
projects.proposed_workbench: 指标和 SQL 审查：模型树、SQL、结果表
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 当前 Python/Rust 语义核心；路径许可映射
projects.decision: 专项；旧 Classic 已停止维护，不沿用旧 UI 立项

projects.name: RAGFlow
projects.proposed_workbench: 文档入库质检：解析队列、原页/切片、召回表
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 当前 Go/native 多服务；Apache-2.0
projects.decision: 专项；已有 Linux 服务时更合适

projects.name: Onyx
projects.proposed_workbench: 企业证据检索：结果、原文、证据篮、同步状态
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 已部署索引与权限；MIT 核心＋EE
projects.decision: 专项；按真实用户权限访问

projects.name: Khoj
projects.proposed_workbench: 私人资料检索：来源筛选、命中段落、收藏集
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: Python＋PostgreSQL/pgvector；AGPLv3
projects.decision: 后续；更适合已有用户

projects.name: LangGraph.js
projects.proposed_workbench: 人工复核流程：执行图、待办卡、检查点时间线
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: Node 核心＋自建模板 SQLite checkpointer；MIT
projects.decision: 首批；不能照搬 better-sqlite3 adapter

implementation.upstream: 真实StateGraph/SQLite与进程重启；Gemini 3.8 Flash经Host完成整理、复核、交付和刷新恢复

projects.name: Promptfoo
projects.proposed_workbench: 评测台：用例×版本矩阵、失败差异、基线
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 外部 runner/真实结果导入；MIT
projects.decision: 首批；当前 Node 最低补丁与 libSQL 依赖须处理

implementation.upstream: 真实Promptfoo evaluator回显评测；外部模型未验证

projects.name: Langfuse
projects.proposed_workbench: 运行复盘：span 瀑布图、成本、人工评分
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: JS/REST 接已有服务；MIT 核心＋EE
projects.decision: 有服务后优先；不移植整个服务集群

projects.name: Mastra
projects.proposed_workbench: 批次加工：任务表、步骤输出、人工回填
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: Node 核心＋存储适配；Apache-2.0＋EE
projects.decision: 后续；与 LangGraph 先二选一

projects.name: Langflow
projects.proposed_workbench: 字段提取：原文、schema、复核结果三栏
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 外部 Python flow API；MIT
projects.decision: 后续；适合已有流程服务

projects.name: Dify
projects.proposed_workbench: 知识库运营：文档/索引队列、检索测试、运行记录
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 外部平台 API；带附加条款的 Apache 派生许可
projects.decision: 有实例再做；单 workspace、前端和多租户边界分开核对

projects.name: Ragas
projects.proposed_workbench: RAG 评测：问题、答案、检索证据、评分分歧
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: Python evaluator＋按指标配置 judge；Apache-2.0
projects.decision: 后续；分数不等于事实正确证明

projects.name: browser-use
projects.proposed_workbench: 网页采集复核：任务队列、步骤截图、数据行
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 外部 Python/browser/model 服务；MIT
projects.decision: 后续；先限定采集与审阅流程

projects.name: OpenHands
projects.proposed_workbench: 工程任务审阅：执行轨迹、diff、测试结果
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 外部 Agent 后端；当前 Canvas Node ≥24；MIT
projects.decision: 暂缓；不直接移入固定 Node 22 模板

projects.name: Flowise
projects.proposed_workbench: 既有流程迁移：节点/变量检查、结果比较
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 现有实例/JSON；Apache-2.0 核心＋商业 EE
projects.decision: 新建不选；官方 EOL、仓库已归档

projects.name: faster-whisper
projects.proposed_workbench: 字幕审校：波形、逐句回听、时间轴、术语表
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 自建 Python 任务服务，CPU 可起步；MIT
projects.decision: 首批；导出 SRT/VTT/逐字稿，保存人工修订

implementation.upstream: 真实tiny.en CPU INT8英语转写，主仓库完整链路复验

projects.name: Presenton
projects.proposed_workbench: 课件制作：逐页大纲、幻灯片舞台、资料引用
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 外部 Docker/self-host API；Apache-2.0
projects.decision: 首批；Electron 版不提供外部 REST/MCP

implementation.upstream: 本地编辑/导出与官方API合同；真实生成和上游文件递送未验证

projects.name: Kokoro
projects.proposed_workbench: 旁白台：分段脚本、试听、声音/速度、音轨
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: Python TTS；代码与指定 Kokoro-82M 权重 Apache-2.0
projects.decision: 条件优先；最后 push 2025-08，先验证依赖与语音效果

projects.name: WhisperX
projects.proposed_workbench: 访谈精编：说话人泳道、逐字稿、低置信片段
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: Python＋转写/对齐/分离模型；代码 BSD-2-Clause
projects.decision: 后续；多人分离需求明确时选择

projects.name: FunASR
projects.proposed_workbench: 中文审听：录音批次、术语修订、事件标签
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: Python/HTTP；代码 MIT，模型含自定义条款
projects.decision: 后续；固定模型与响应合约后验证

projects.name: ComfyUI
projects.proposed_workbench: 视觉素材生产：配方、参数、生成队列、对比墙
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 外部模型/GPU 服务；后端 GPL-3.0，权重单列
projects.decision: 有设施后优先；先固定图像配方，再扩视频

projects.name: InvokeAI
projects.proposed_workbench: 局部改图：大画布、蒙版、版本、前后对照
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: Python 3.12 与模型服务；代码 Apache-2.0
projects.decision: 后续；适合连续修图，完整画布另行适配

projects.name: Wan2.2
projects.proposed_workbench: 短片分镜：镜头卡、参考图、播放器、多版本
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 外部 GPU worker；代码与指定 TI2V-5B 权重 Apache-2.0
projects.decision: 专项；官方 TI2V-5B 路线需至少 24GB VRAM

projects.name: IOPaint
projects.proposed_workbench: 修补参考：蒙版、原图/结果滑杆、历史
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: 既有 Python 实例；代码 Apache-2.0
projects.decision: 新建不选；已归档，转换权重来源许可未完整核清

projects.name: F5-TTS
projects.proposed_workbench: 配音实验：参考素材、角色脚本、试听时间轴
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: Python；代码 MIT，官方权重 CC-BY-NC-4.0
projects.decision: 暂缓默认商业用途；代码许可不覆盖权重限制

projects.name: CopilotKit
projects.proposed_workbench: 上下文、结构化操作预览、Agent 状态交互
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: MIT；需 Host/AG-UI 适配，Intelligence 另计
projects.decision: 为明确业务操作按需引入

projects.name: assistant-ui
projects.proposed_workbench: 消息/工具部件、对话分支、外部状态适配
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: MIT；React 包支持 19，整仓构建要求 Node 24.11+
projects.decision: 作为局部 UI，不直接复制整仓

projects.name: Transformers.js
projects.proposed_workbench: 分类、标注、音频等本地推理引擎
projects.requirements_and_license_summary: Apache-2.0；模型单列；浏览器 WASM/CSP 和 Node native 关卡
projects.decision: 暂缓内嵌，保留独立推理服务路线
